page.layout: Two circular medallion portraits side by side at top, with their inscriptions; below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. Page number and running head at top. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: II. IMP.
MAXIMILIANVS
MARIA RO.
IMP. MAXIM. VXOR [?]
MAXIMILIANVS secundus Iunior Austrius Ferdi-
nandi filius,à rege Boëmiæ,Frácfortdiæ Rex Romanorũ Cæsar-
que octauo Kalendas Decembris,1562. creatus fuit,ibidémque
coronatus, regnauit cum patre Ferdinando, per anni spatiũ &
octo mesiũ:quo tępore,ordo militiæ S.Stephani Papæ in Insula
Iluæ,à Cosmo Medice Florentinorum Duce institutus, à Pio 4.
pontifice maximo cõfirmatur, & bella plusquam hostilia in re-
gno Galliarũ,ob religionẽ excitata, Ducis Guisij viri præclariss-
imi,acerba catholicis cæde, sedantur.Hic tanto amore non so-
lũ à suis sed etiã ab omnibus est ( non immerito ) profecutus, ut
humani generis amor & delitiæ, appellatus fit. Imperauit post
patris obitũ,annos plures,tanta cum moderatione & iustitia,ut
erepti mortem omnes sui ægrè tulerint & defleuerint diù. Hu-
ius filia prudentissima Elisabetha collocata est in matrimonium
Carolo nono Francorũ Regi,qui filiam ex ea fuscepit,quę paulo
post eius obitum,& matris apud suos reditum,mortua est.
MARIA Caroli v. filia,Maximiliani ii. Romanorum Im-
peratoris defuncti uxor,Ferdinandi nurus: & Philippi, Hispa-
niarum Regis foror, ea pignora suis tradidit, quæ summorum,
summæque familiæ principum nomina illis renouarent, idque
viuens ipsa vidit, quod in maxima fœlicitatis parte omnes lo-
candum putant, filias duas summis orbis terrarum Regibus in
matrimonium collocatas. Hæc maxima sunt, quæque nescio
an unquam contigerint: sed maiora illa, quæ ipsi propria sunt,
Pietas in Deũ, charitas, qua tenuiores assiduè subleuat, & præ-
cipuum studium catholicæ religionis: quæ posteritas non silebit ulla.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions are set in capitals around the portraits; the right-hand medallion's right-hand inscription is only partly legible and is marked [?]. Printed "Frácfortdiæ" and "ibidémque" carry an accent as printed. "Caroli v." and "Maximiliani ii." are printed with lower-case roman numerals; kept as printed. The paragraph text is set in a slightly blurred impression; words marked by reading are not otherwise doubtful.
